nameEn: Support activities for petroleum and natural gas extraction
description: This class includes oil and gas field services performed on a fee or contract basis: directional drilling and redrilling; derrick building, repair and dismantling; cementing oil and gas well casings; pumping of oil and gas wells; plugging and abandoning wells; liquid mud preparation for drilling; chemical treatment of oil and gas wells; oil and gas well testing.
includes: oil and gas field services: directional drilling and redrilling
cementing oil and gas well casings
pumping of oil and gas wells
chemical treatment of oil and gas wells
excludes: oil and gas field machinery and equipment manufacturing, see 2819
